flagship_programmes.name: Electrical Installation
flagship_programmes.description: Prepares learners to install, maintain, test, and troubleshoot electrical systems in residential, commercial, and industrial environments.

flagship_programmes.name: Solar Photovoltaic Installer
flagship_programmes.description: Develops practical skills in solar PV installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and renewable-energy technologies.

flagship_programmes.name: Solar Electrician
flagship_programmes.description: Combines electrical installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, equipment repair, and solar-system design.
flagship_programmes.examining_body: NITA Wireman Grade III or Solar T1

flagship_programmes.name: Solar Upskilling
flagship_programmes.description: An intensive practical programme for electrical practitioners seeking competencies in solar design and grid-tied systems.
flagship_programmes.entry_requirement: Evidence of electrical training or industry experience

flagship_programmes.name: Advanced Welding with VR Technology
flagship_programmes.description: Combines practical welding with virtual-reality simulations to improve precision, safety, and productivity.
flagship_programmes.qualification: Advanced Welding Skills Certificate and VR Welding Certificate

flagship_programmes.name: Advanced Welding Upskilling with VR Technology
flagship_programmes.description: A specialist programme for practising welders who want to advance their skills using VR technology.
flagship_programmes.entry_requirement: Prior welding training or industry experience

flagship_programmes.name: Climate Smart Agriculture
flagship_programmes.description: Builds practical knowledge in climate-resilient agriculture, organic farming, and agribusiness development.
